articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Adobe, Salesforce, & the software stock slump: How to play the sector. It has been a rough start for software stocks, with names like Adobe (ADBE) and Salesforce (CRM) down more than 10%, and Microsoft (MSFT) down about 5%. The Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC), meanwhile, is up about 1%.  Third Bridge Global Sector Lead for Technology, Media, and Telecom Scott Kessler shares his advice for how investors can play these stocks now. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime. Related tickers mentioned: CRM, IGV, MSFT, ^IXIC.
